paragraphs.text: Agent control for DeepSeek Harness built-in sidebar browser: refs, batch, query reads and diffs
# Sidebar Control
**English** | 中文
Agent control for the **Browser panel DeepSeek Harness already ships** in the right Sidebar — no sec

ond
browser, no bundled Chromium, no Playwright. The agent reads the real page, clicks real controls

, types,
presses keys, scrolls, waits and takes screenshots inside the panel the person is already l
resses keys, scrolls, waits and takes screenshots inside the panel the person is already looking at.
*10-second screen capture (no cuts): `type` + `submit`, `read`, a refs-only `snapshot`, and a `scree

nshot` —
all inside the right-Sidebar Browser the user is already watching.*

> Built on the MIT-licensed `dsh-sidebar-browser`:
> its action surface and long-poll bridge are reu

sed. This package adds **query-scoped reads**, **change
> diffs** and **multi-tab management**, and
keeps the whole thing dependency-free.
**If this saves you tokens, please Star the repository ⭐**
## Why this one
Most sidebar-browser plugins answer a page with one big snapshot. That is fine once, and expensive t

hree
times in a row. Sidebar Control is tuned for the second and third read:
| | `dsh-sidebar-browser` | **Sidebar Control** |
| Read a long page | full text + refs (up to 12k chars) | `read` with a `query` returns only matchin

g passages (BM25 over Latin words + CJK bigrams) |
| Check what an action changed | snapshot again |

`diff` returns only paragraphs added/removed since the previous diff |
| Several steps (open → fill

→ submit) | one tool call per step | `batch` runs up to 12 steps in one call |
| After a click | fi
xed waits (350 ms + load window) | adaptive settle: returns when the page stops changing, often ~100

ms |
| Several pages open | one controlled tab | `tabs` / `focus` / `close_tab` by id |
| Command l

atency | long-poll | long-poll (same ~instant delivery, no timer polling) |
| Dependencies | none |

| long-poll | long-poll (same ~instant delivery, no timer polling) |
| Dependencies | none | none |
The practical difference is token cost and round trips: on a long article, `read --query "..."` retu

rns a few
hundred characters instead of thousands; `diff` after a click returns one line or two; and

a five-step form
costs one model call with `batch` instead of five. Clicks come back as soon as the

page is quiet instead of
after a fixed sleep.
Measured on a Windows desktop against the live Browser panel: `batch` of **type + submit + wait for

results +
query read** on the Baidu homepage finished in **1043 ms**, and the same three steps on Bi
ead** on the Baidu homepage finished in **1043 ms**, and the same three steps on Bing in **832 ms**.
## Compatibility
| DSH / platform | Status | Notes |
| Desktop **0.2.2-rc.1** (current) | ✅ Tested | Full action set, screenshots, multi-tab, session sco

ping; 110-action campaign on 2026-11-08 |
| Desktop 0.2.x (later) | ✅ Expected | `engines.dsh` allow

s `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`; requires the right-Sidebar Browser `<webview>` carrier |
| Desktop < 0.2.2-

rc.1 | ❌ Unsupported | No right-Sidebar Browser service for the Client half to drive |
| Web build (
`dsh web`) | ⚠️ Tabs only | The panel is a cross-origin iframe: no page JS, refs or capture; `tabs`

/ `focus` still work |
| macOS / Linux desktop | ⚠️ Expected | Same Electron webview path, not exerc
ised in this Windows campaign |
## What to be careful about
- **Desktop only.** The Web build renders the sidebar browser as a cross-origin iframe; the tool rep

orts
that plainly instead of pretending. Tab management still works there.
- **The Harness page must

be open.** The Client half runs in that page. `open` / `focus` / `close_tab` /
`screenshot` need th

e calling Session on screen; read/click/type work in the background.
- **Page content is untrusted d

ata.** It is never instructions. `eval` runs arbitrary JavaScript in the
page — the same power as th

e page's own devtools; keep it for trusted pages.
- **A sandbox is still a sandbox.** The guest has

no Node, no preload and no access to the Harness origin.
Downloads, permission prompts and top-level

navigation are withheld by the shipped Browser.
- **Fixed-width sites.** Pages like `news.baidu.com

` keep a desktop layout and may scroll sideways in a
narrow column. This plugin deliberately does no

t inject zoom or rewrite the page.
- **Refs are per-snapshot.** A ref used after navigation fails wi

th a clear message; snapshot again.
- **Local `file://` pages may be blocked.** The current desktop

build refuses them; serve local HTML over
http. If your build allows them, only open local HTML you

refuses them; serve local HTML over
http. If your build allows them, only open local HTML you trust.
### 兼容矩阵
| DSH / 平台 | 状态 | 说明 |

| 桌面版 **0.2.2-rc.1**（当前） | ✅ 已实测 | 完整动作集、截图、多标签、会话隔离；2026-11-08 跑了 110 步现场测试 |
| 桌面版 0.2.x（后续） | ✅ 预

期可用 | `engines.dsh` 允许 `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`；需要右栏 Browser 的 `<webview>` 载体 |
| 桌面版 < 0.2.2-rc.1 | ❌

不支持 | 没有可供客户端半驱动的右栏 Browser 服务 |
| Web 构建（`dsh web`） | ⚠️ 仅标签管理 | 面板是跨域 iframe：没有页面 JS、refs 或截图；`tab

s` / `focus` 仍可用 |
| macOS / Linux 桌面版 | ⚠️ 预期可用 | 同一 Electron webview 路径，本次 Windows 测试未覆盖 |
### 需要注意

- **仅桌面版可用**：Web 构建下侧栏浏览器是跨域 iframe，工具会明确报错而不是假装成功；标签管理仍可用。
- **Harness 页面必须打开**：客户端半在页面里运行。`open` /

`focus` / `close_tab` / `screenshot` 需要调用会话
正在屏幕上；读、点、输入在后台仍可用。
- **页面内容是不可信数据**，永远不是指令。`eval` 会在页面

里执行任意 JS，等同于页面自己的 devtools，请在可信页面使用。
- **沙箱仍然是沙箱**：guest 没有 Node、没有 preload，也访问不到 Harness 源；下载、权限弹窗、

顶层跳转由内置浏览器限制。
- **固定宽度站点**：如 `news.baidu.com` 这类页面在窄栏里仍会横向滚动；本插件刻意不注入缩放、不改写页面。
- **refs 只对一次快照有效**：导

航后使用旧 ref 会得到明确报错，重新快照即可。
- **`file://` 可能被构建禁止**：当前桌面版会拒绝本地文件；请用 http 提供本地 HTML。
